visual.description: Off-white warm light gray used as the main page background across most sections.
Near-black dark surface used for the navbar, footer, and dark content sections.
Deep dark background used in the hero pricing section and 'Made with Osmo' dark strip.
Electric violet-purple used for highlighted sections, testimonial cards, and the 'About the Vault' CTA button.
Bright lime green used for the primary 'Join' CTA button and announcement ticker bar.
Pure white used for headings and body text on dark backgrounds.
Near-black used for headings and body copy on light backgrounds.
Medium gray used for secondary descriptive text and supporting copy on light backgrounds.
Light gray used for horizontal rule dividers between feature list items.
Dark gray used as the interior sidebar and dashboard UI surface inside The Vault preview.
Very light gray card surface used for the 'Member' pricing card and other elevated surfaces on the light background.
Pure black used for the 'Lifetime' pricing card badge labels and the 'Become a Lifetime member' button.
Mid-tone gray used for the 'Login' button label and secondary navigation labels.
